summary: Nightly 2026-08-09 (2nd run today): 26/26 attempted, 18 success. Wowhead rebuilt its M+ healer list (Presv/Resto C->B), moving 2 forecast scores; 0 consensus letters. WCL rDPS still broken.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by urllib with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 207-362 KB. Parsed <table class="tier-list">: first <td> = tier letter, tier-list-entry img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster (spell-icon alts in the same cell are correctly dropped). 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Era-verified per <title>: raid DPS "Midnight (12.0.7)", raid tank "Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1", the other four "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" — Season 1, no season flip, seasonVerified stays s1 on all 6 pages. Page-own JSON-LD dateModified re-read and unchanged (raid healer 2026-08-04, raid tank 2026-06-30, the other four 2026-07-01), agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. This is the second refresh of this UTC day (the 10:37Z nightly ran first), so the stored dates hold at 2026-08-09 rather than advancing.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 215-348 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)" — the correct 12.1 page, not a Season 1 mis-serve. 40 rows on the 7-band icyveins-ptr scale (S+/S/A+/A/B+/B/C), no spec left TBD, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. published re-read from the page itself (JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-02 on all three, i.e. the Update #4 rebuild) and NOT carried forward — matches published-evidence/evidence.json 3/3; a 7-day-old published date is normal for a list rebuilt Sundays. Era-gated out of the live consensus by the registry, as designed.

Both pages fetched live, HTTP 200 (160 KB M+ / 149 KB raid). Parsed the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, img alt = "Spec Class"). 79 assignments: M+ 40/40, raid 39/40 — Vengeance Demon Hunter is still absent from the raid list, the documented long-standing Method omission, so it is omitted rather than invented. ZERO tier moves. Era-verified from the body copy: "Midnight Season 1 Raids: The Voidspire, The Dreamrift and March on Quel'Danas" and "Midnight Season 1" on the M+ page — seasonVerified stays s1. (The "Season 3" string in the raw HTML is a stale meta-description artifact, not the list's own season claim.)

All 6 pages fetched live with the full browser header set, HTTP 200, 71-314 KB. Wowhead REMAINS on Season 2 (all six titles read "Midnight Season 2", bodies reference the Venomous Abyss and Patch 12.1), so seasonVerified stays s2 and the source stays season-ahead: out of the live consensus, into the 12.1 forecast's external-letter lane, with its final S1 letters held by the frozen lane. Tiers parsed from the embedded WH.markup [tier-list=rows] block ([tier-label] letter + [spec-badge=slug]); 80 assignments, 0 unmatched. TWO moves, both on the M+ healer page, which upstream rebuilt TODAY: Preservation Evoker C->B and Restoration Druid C->B. That page's own dateModified advanced 2026-08-08 -> 2026-08-09 (confirmed by published-evidence/evidence.json) and its stored published was updated to match; the other five pages stay at 2026-08-08.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in raw HTML (specTierListSection.tierLists[]): raid from the metric "throughput" list, M+ from "score" — never the default popularity grouping. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Page lastUpdated now reads 2026-08-09T12:00:00Z. Era: the pages self-identify as 12.0.7 with the Season 1 boss/dungeon set (Imperator..Midnight Falls, Algeth'ar Academy..Windrunner Spire), so seasonVerified stays s1.

Full re-fetch of all 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200, 0 failures, each resolving to 40/40 specs (680 tier rows total). Every per-encounter tier came back byte-identical to the committed state, so data/encounter-tiers.json was left untouched rather than rewritten with an identical payload. Its asOf already reads 2026-08-09 from the earlier run today.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 rows merged via apply-metrics' survivability key. 16 of 40 moved one band on this cut (six A->B, eight B->C, Restoration Shaman B->A, Preservation Evoker C->B) — a re-cut of Archon's own clustering against a fresh 14-day window. It is not a letter-consensus input; it renders only in the drawer's Source ratings box.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) on the raid DPS + tank pages = 33 rows with n = parses. Healers are deliberately excluded even though their page also exposes a dps column, so the series keeps meaning "DPS and tank throughput". Values identical to the cut stored this morning (Archon's daily aggregate is stamped 2026-08-09T12:00:00Z); range 89-186k.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses, at the 2026-08-09T12:00:00Z aggregate. Values unchanged against the stored cut.
"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column = 40/40 specs with n = parses. Values unchanged against the stored cut; no row lost.

80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention (rounding finer rewrites all 80 rows for nothing). Shape-checked: range 0.5-38.4, no DPS-magnitude values leaking into the percentage series.

Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale S3 HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both HTTP 200. 40 rows selected by the {dps,hps,tank} + sortField==lowerBound + keyRange==undefined whitelist (melee/ranged are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs) and re-merged unchanged at 2 decimals. But manifest.snapshotDate is STILL 2026-08-05 — a fourth consecutive night with no upstream pipeline run — and asOf is the source's own snapshot date, never today, so a success claim would be dishonest. Coverage date stays 4 days old against maxAgeDays 8.

This agent holds NO Warcraft Logs credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means. Its only WCL input is the pre-agent deterministic step's wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-09T19:46:17Z), verdict "rdps-broken": characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 still returns a bare "Internal server error" while OAuth and GraphQL transport are healthy. The zone-46 Mythic rDPS/HPS medians are an rDPS-family cut, so nothing could land and the stored 2026-08-07 rows are untouched.

Same cause as wcl-live-raid: no credentials held, no warcraftlogs.com fetch attempted, and the evidence verdict "rdps-broken" means the zone-47 "(M+, all dungeons)" rDPS/HPS medians cannot honestly land. Stored rows unchanged at 2026-08-07.

Zone-54 "12.1 PTR raid testing score (normalized)" is unreachable for the same reason — no credentials, evidence verdict "rdps-broken", and the normalized cross-boss score has no working API analogue while the rdps family 500s. The 34 stored rows stay at 2026-07-28; maxAgeDays for this key is 40, so the freeze is still inside contract.
Zone-56 "Mythic+ Season 2 (PTR)" rDPS/HPS medians — no credentials held, no fetch attempted, evidence verdict "rdps-broken". Stored rows unchanged at 2026-08-07.

spec.ptrDummy (zone 52 median rDPS by target count) is an rDPS-family series and stays frozen with the other four cuts: no credentials, no fetch, evidence verdict "rdps-broken". 27 stored specs unchanged at 2026-08-07. It is NOT substituted by the raw-DPS Dummy Dome series below — that is a different statistic and must never be dressed up as rDPS.

Landed by the deterministic pre-agent fetch step itself (frozen recipe, owner-approved 2026-07-17) — this agent only READ the evidence and never re-fetched, recomputed or edited a row. evidence.landed["wcl-dummy-raw"] = 104 rows built and applied for "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Dummy Dome, NT)", ranked players per encounter 1T 2000 / 2T 623 / 3T 284 / 5T 2000. 106 rows are stored in total; the two extras are older per-spec-per-count rows for specs that logged no parse at that count this run.

Also landed by the deterministic step: evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-raid-raw"] = 27 rows built and applied, pooled across the Venomous Abyss bosses. Six of eight bosses populated (Nek'zali 370, Entombed Sentinels 363, Vashnik 678, Lost Explorers 150, Sszorak 184, Twin Fangs 146 ranked players); The Coiled Altar and Ula'tek report 0 players — a testing window that has not run, not an error. Agent-side: read only.

Also landed by the deterministic step: evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-mplus-raw"] = 27 rows built and applied, pooled across all 8 Season 2 PTR dungeons, every one at the 2000-player pagination ceiling. Agent-side: read only.

All three meta pages (dps/healer/tank M+) fetched by plain GET, HTTP 200, 40-70 KB — never r.jina.ai, which does not work on murlok. 40/40 "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" rows; ZERO values moved against the cut stored this morning. Parse gotcha re-hit and worth keeping: the meta-item anchor writes its attributes in either order (class-first or href-first), so a regex anchored on '<a class="vi-box meta-item' silently drops 5 specs (Frost/Fire Mage, Marksmanship, Destruction Warlock, one tank) — match '<a [^>]*class="[^"]*meta-item' instead.

All 27 DPS specs requested from talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk; 26 charts returned with simc_settings.tier == MID1 and Augmentation Evoker returned the {"status":"error"} body on all 3 retries (the documented genuine absence, retried rather than assumed). asOf is each CHART's own timestamp, never the run date: 25 specs stamped 2026-07-08 and Elemental Shaman 2026-07-15, unchanged, with 0 of 26 target sets moving a value. That is 32 days without a re-sim against maxAgeDays 5, so the heartbeat should go red here — the red IS the signal (2026-08-08 honest-date correction), not something to paper over.

MID1_Raid.html fetched live, HTTP 200, 37.2 MB. It is the SAME completed report as the last two runs — SimC 1205-01, WoW 12.0.7.68974 (hotfix 2026-08-06), git build 678e66d384, Timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000 — so asOf stays the report's own date and the row is partial. All 26 DPS values re-derived and identical to stored (best hero-talent build per spec, tanks excluded). PARSE GOTCHA WORTH RECORDING: hero-talent profile names can contain a HYPHEN (MID1_Demon_Hunter_Havoc_Fel-Scarred, ..._Devourer_Void-Scarred), so a [A-Za-z_'0-9] name class silently drops Havoc entirely and reads Devourer off its lesser build (115175 instead of 118341) — include '-' in the profile-name pattern. The concurrently published MID1_Raid.txt is a live in-progress log of a NEWER run (git e5e7634a61, 4 of 49 profiles) with no ranking block yet, so nothing there was ingestible.

Fetched DIRECTLY (r.jina.ai still 403s on this host): /period/latest is server-rendered, HTTP 200, 206 KB. Period 1075, week 20 of MID1, top 2000 keys / 10000 characters (3949 unique) / 21.8 average key. 39 of 40 specs parsed from the bar list (alt labels are hyphenated per class — normalise before roster matching) and re-merged at 2026-08-09; 0 values moved. Devastation Evoker is absent from the figure entirely (0 hits for its slug in the raw HTML), a genuine upstream absence, so its stored 0.0% row keeps its older 2026-08-07 date rather than being invented.

No new build to log — the feed is unchanged at 15 entries, newest the 2026-08-06 launch patch notes. All three channels checked. (1) Official thread 2317811.json: highest_post_number is still 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31), already logged. (2) Wowhead news RSS (40 items, 2026-08-02..2026-08-09, bodies read from content:encoded): the 12.1 items are Jimothy datamined in the latest PTR build (a cosmetic model), More Season 2 M+ Dungeon Tuning (Ruby Life Pools / Temple of Sethraliss encounter tuning), Datamined Hotfixes (M+/raid/delve ability FLAGS), Embellishment and Potion tuning (items), the Atrophic Poison deep dive (a community finding about an existing Rogue raid buff, not a Blizzard change) and the Blizzard/Icy Veins/Raider.IO interview, in which Blizzard says the Season 2 class-tuning ROADMAP ships "in the next couple of days" — a lead to watch, not tuning data. None carries a per-spec tuning line. (3) Standalone blue posts: swept via the forum's own Discourse search; @Kaivax posts since 2026-08-01 are season-end, housing, server and M+ score topics with no class tuning, and @Linxy has none. Also re-checked writeup material for the 9 specs still at ptr: null (Frost DK, Feral/Guardian/Restoration Druid, Holy Priest, Elemental Shaman, all three Warlocks): no spec-review article for any of them appeared in the RSS window and Wowhead's own news search is Cloudflare-403 to this runner, so they honestly stay null.

All 42 distinct YouTube channels in community.json (39 specialist + 3 general; 114 class entries, several creators registered under more than one class) polled via the RSS feed endpoint — 42/42 HTTP 200, zero failures, and no direct YouTube or transcript-API access by this agent. Seen-set rebuilt from the four structured lanes (queued + skipped + seen + every youtu.be id in takes/metaNotes) = 737 ids; 113 unseen videos on or after the cycle bound 2026-06-18, 0 pre-cycle. transcript-fetch/summary.json verdict "ok" with 0 requested / 0 fetched — the queue was empty when the deterministic step ran (today's local run had drained it), so there was nothing to distil and NO take or metaNote was added or changed. 4 videos queued for the next deterministic transcript run, keyword-filtered as the nightly must be against the 100-request monthly Supadata budget and chosen where a take could actually move something: izen's "Season 2 Mythic+ DPS Meta" (the general-lane metaNote archetype, and his stored metaNotes are weeks old), Sha's 08-09 PTR stream (Brewmaster — the standing raid-scoped tank gap), MadSkillzzTV's 12.1 healer prep, and leak's 12.1 Survival video (his Survival takes predate the 07-31 tuning pass). Deliberately NOT queued: YoDaTV's eight Season 2 dungeon guides (route/mechanics content, and his M+ tank takes are already 08-08), Supatease's PvP tier list and arena streams (PvP is out of scope for a PvE tracker), and the June/July backlog whose videos predate their creators' current live takes and would only dilute them. Those stay unrecorded rather than written to seen[], so a local yt-dlp run can still sweep them for free.
